body:
Original evidence: Actions run 41759139590, attempt1, exact head c6083135f3cb2723e849d7b4f9d7dee89898e5c6; artifact13288684528 (ZIP SHA256 8c28964fe5e2ee70e4b822e43fb9ff5f763bfc629d90b9dde097f3a248514971). JOBS_BUDGET_PREFLIGHT failed with RUN_INVENTORY_INCOMPLETE: reported213/returned100/max_job_requests20. Deadlock analysis was skipped. The original budget CLI reproduces the310-byte report byte-for-byte, exit2.

PR675 already merged the fail-closed budget guard. Its guard is retained. This successor fixes the collector: paginate all exact-head metadata; deterministically request the union of the latest run per workflow and every active run, at most20 actual per-run jobs GETs. Preserve older completed metadata with an explicit unobserved-job marker; bind analysis to the complete inventory and exact plan. Missing, inconsistent, denied or truncated observations remain HOLD; no sampled success, budget increase, retry timer, credentials or new executor.

Current repair base e1ac5f52896b494eb9051f704a42d4554d4b7139 / tree22095e5fb54a0e864660b5140829cb0ab78f826a. Existing original watcher/script/docs/tests/work unit are the implementation carriers. Acceptance: regressions for213 runs over3 pages; all-active/latest union;20/21 boundary; incomplete pages; duplicate IDs/head drift; missing/truncated jobs; unchanged403 stop behavior; original analyzer decision parity; full make test, integrity, then applicable native exact-head checks and conditional integration.

This issue closes on verified source integration. Original-host HTTPS525, protected original SSO/runtime delivery, actual peer confirmation and full universal productive-effect proof remain separate OPEN duties. Source repair and CI do not establish EFFECT_ACK_DONE.

Human requirement/authorization: Ingolf Lohmann. Implementation and bounded verification: OpenAI Codex.
title: fix(watchdog): complete exact-head run inventory within the 20-job readback budget
